items.title: Pay invoice for puppy course and private lesson
items.quote: Zahlbar 14 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum per Überweisung.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 21.11.2026 (Saturday), which is the start event of the period. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event is not counted, so the 14-day period starts on 22.11.2026 and runs 14 days, ending on 05.12.2026. 05.12.2026 falls on a Saturday. This is a payment owed to a private company; the payer lives in NRW. Under §193 BGB, since the last day of the period is a Saturday, the deadline moves to the next working day. 06.12.2026 is a Sunday, so the next working day is Monday, 07.12.2026, which is not a public holiday in NRW. Therefore the payment is due by 07.12.2026.
